name: Pixreel – Product Video Gallery for WooCommerce
author: fenal

sections.description:
Pixreel – Product Video Gallery for WooCommerce lets store owners showcase products with video — YouTube embeds or self-hosted MP4 files — directly inside the WooCommerce product gallery.

Features

  • Add unlimited YouTube and MP4 videos per product
  • Drag-and-drop reorder videos in the admin metabox
  • Set custom thumbnails per video with automatic YouTube poster fallback
  • Built-in responsive lightbox with keyboard navigation and fullscreen support
  • Optional shortcode [pixreel_product_gallery] to use the bundled gallery anywhere
  • Customisable arrow color, dot color, active border, thumbnail size, and play icon
  • Translation-ready (.pot file included)
  • HPOS (custom order tables) compatible
  • No third-party services or paid dependencies
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Edit any product. Use the Product Videos metabox in the sidebar to add YouTube URLs or MP4 attachments and drag to reorder.
  4. (Optional) Go to Pixreel Video Gallery → Settings to customise colors, sizes, and the play icon.
  5. (Optional) Drop [pixreel_product_gallery] anywhere on a product page to render the bundled gallery.
sections.faq:
Does it require any paid plugin?

No. Everything is bundled and completely free.

Will it slow down my store?

No. Frontend scripts and styles are only loaded on product pages where they are needed for optimal performance.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares custom_order_tables compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS.

Can I use MP4 files hosted elsewhere?

Yes. The plugin supports self-hosted MP4 files added via the WordPress media library.
